question.text: The avalanche strategy for debt repayment involves:

answer.text: Paying off the loan with the smallest balance first
Paying off the loan with the highest interest rate first
Paying equal amounts towards all loans simultaneously
Consolidating all loans into a single new loan

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 85 of the workbook states that the avalanche strategy pays off loans/borrowings with the highest interest rates first because they are the most costly, which reduces the overall interest burden over time. The Trap: Don't confuse avalanche (highest interest rate first) with the snowball method (smallest balance first). The two methods sort the debt queue using different criteria. Note: Under avalanche, once the highest-interest debt is closed, the freed-up cashflow is redirected to the next-highest interest-rate debt.
